info.name: Pharmacy Management System - Complete API v1
info.description: Complete API collection for Pharmacy Management System with all modules: Suppliers, Stores, Purchase Orders, Ingredients, Recipes, Production, Medicines, Inventory, Stock Transfers, Customers, Prescriptions, Sales, Alerts, Users, and File Upload. All endpoints use API v1 versioning.
